references.text: Confirms the identity of Hezron and Ram within a broader genealogical context.
Confirms and expands the lineage by linking Amminadab to Nahshon, the leader of Judah.
Confirms the same genealogical line (Hezron -> Aram/Ram) in the New Testament genealogy.
Places Hezron as the son of Perez, providing the preceding link in the genealogy before Ruth 4:19 begins.
Confirms the same lineage (Aram/Ram -> Aminadab/Amminadab -> Nahshon) in Matthew's genealogy.
